description: Money-free world state after C1c-2 (engine 5b138e0: arable fields, farmsteads, v10) for the in-repo cases, from scripts/ledgerBalanceTrace.ts . <case> <ticks> [state]. finalWorldHashWithoutMoney is canonicalStateHash of the final state without treasuryCoin, coinLedger, ledger, money and Building.upkeepUnpaid. C1c-2 changes the world by design (wheat now grows on arable strips, spec AF-*), so the pre-C2 world of 4950b10 no longer applies; this pins the C1c-2 world. The cache must still match the ledger on every tick.
